turns.question: What was the median, across the ten long-standing customers, of each customer's total non-cancelled order amount from 17 August to 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: it has no median across customers of per-customer revenue (the only median, median order value, is not available here and is per order, not per customer), and no definition of "long-standing customers" or per-customer dimension to select them, so I cannot give this figure. The closest metrics are Revenue (EUR) (sum of amount for non-cancelled orders), Active customers (distinct customers with at least one non-cancelled order), Average order value (EUR) and Repeat customers / Revenue from repeat customers (EUR); I can compute any of these for 17 August to 2 October 2026 if one of them answers your need.
